subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Diagram in WI-12. (C)OP-SPD (option spread) is crossed with EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis). 'Option spread' is one of Braxton's central diagnostic terms in the WI section — the differential range of choices available to white vs. non-white creative people in this cycle. The diagram poses what option-spread crossed with expansion-information-basis actually shapes. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → OP-SPD; A-PR (all-purpose) → OP-SPD; EXP-INFO-B → OP-SPD (forming a third upstream feed) and EXP-INFO-B → EXT-FT (extended functionalism). BIA (bi-aitional) also → EXT-FT. EXT-FT → INTR (interpretation) → AFL-DT (affinity dictates) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). OP-SPD outputs to POL-DYM (political dynamics) → TRS (transition). Structural argument: option spread is co-constituted by spiritual dynamics, all-purpose, *and* expansion-information-basis. Its primary downstream output is political-dynamics → transition. Extended functionalism is fed independently by expansion-information-basis and bi-aitionalism, and produces interpretation → affinity-dictates → social-reality-dynamics — a chain that *defines* what social reality looks like. The diagram thus stages the structural advantage Braxton names: option spread is over-determined upstream (three independent feeds, including spiritual dynamics), and its political-dynamics output drives transition, while the parallel extended-functionalism chain dictates social reality through affinity dictates. The white improvisor's option spread is, structurally, the ability to occupy *both* of these chains simultaneously.
